judgment.status_reasoning: The government press kit of 8 November 2021 says the first phase of the national AI strategy (2018-2022) has come to an end and the Government launches a second phase; no stored text repeals the 2018 strategy formally, so Superseded rests on that statement and a human may prefer another value.

open_questions: There is no single strategy document: the strategy is described by two government press kits (28 Nov 2018, 8 Nov 2021) and the President's speech; every quote is from an announcement, so the record cannot go above level B from these files.
